newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-FERREIRA RESCUES BOLAND AGAINST GRIQUAS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FERREIRA RESCUES BOLAND AGAINST GRIQUAS.

text.p: Opening batsman Lloyd Ferreira led a gutsy Boland fightback on the opening day of their four-day Supersport Series cricket match against Griqualand West in Paarl on Friday.
A maiden first-class century from Ferreira paved the way for the home team's recovery as they reached 268 all out after they had earlier slumped to 133 for six.
By stumps Griquas had reached seven without loss with captain Mickey Arthur (three) and Martyn Gidley (one) the unbeaten batsmen.

Arthur won the toss and asked the home side to bat in what appeared to be favourable conditions. But Antigua-born Vaughn Walsh and former Eastern Province bowler Garth Roe extracted bounce out of the recently-laid Boland Bank Park pitch, forcing Boland's openers Ferreira and Elmar Liebenberg to fend off some uncomfortable deliveries.

Boland lost three wickets in the first session before Ferreira stood firm after lunch and he and Leicestershire professional David Millns added a face-saving 85 runs for the seventh-wicket partnership before Ferreira was caught at cover by Pieter Barnrd off Roe for 127.
